title: Docs and skill guidance: the topology is taught, not only enforced
action: Docs AND skill guidance per staging-lane D0/D0a plus the user's 2026-08-17 direction: beyond CLI teeth, the skills must TEACH the main/staging/worktree flow so an agent understands it before any guard fires. (1) handbook/register.md: staging commands, staging.json store, commands.staging_build config, both refusal codes, the no-escape rule for staging-into-main. (2) New area doc docs/knowledge/areas/worktree-parallelism/staging-mixing-ground.md: the invariant 'staging = main + sum of features awaiting UAT', the three update triggers, disposability, history-is-garbage, teeth — cite D0/D0a and uat-gate-before-merge D1; frontmatter/index per bundle conventions (copy a sibling concept file's shape). (3) bee-hive references/routing-and-contracts.md: one short 'Topology' passage — main clean and integration-only, feature worktrees the only place code truth changes, staging the disposable mixing ground the user tests at, uat gate the switch between them; where routing mentions worktrees, point to it. (4) bee-swarming SKILL.md close step: 'ready for user testing' points at bee staging add + the staging build (falling back to the feature worktree when the host repo has no staging build); after the user's uat approval the merge to main follows, then the staging rebuild nudge. (5) bee-planning SKILL.md: the worktree-first route line names the topology in one clause (feature worktree now, staging at close, main only after uat). (6) role-merge.md: after a landed merge, run/suggest bee staging rebuild (trigger 3). (7) AGENTS.md: extend the existing worktree-first bullet by one sentence naming staging as the user-testing ground and the uat gate as the door to main — smallest possible edit, AGENTS.md is always-loaded context. Keep every edit minimal and in each file's own voice; guidance teaches the WHY (invariant + triggers), guards keep the teeth. Tests: suite green (skill-tree/prompt fixtures may pin text — align them as part of the cell).

truths: register.md documents commands, store, config, refusals
area doc states the invariant and three triggers with citations
bee-hive, bee-planning, bee-swarming, and AGENTS.md each teach their slice of the topology
